name: Kittiwake Inns
description: Pub and inn company with 9 sites in the fictional region of Northfell.

items.title: Quiz night details
items.content: Quiz nights run every Wednesday at 20:15; teams of up to 6 play for a $75 bar tab. Poster KWI-QZ-6.

items.title: Room rates
items.content: Rooms start at $89 a night midweek and $112 at weekends, breakfast included. Rate card KWI-RM-89.

items.title: Cellar management rules
items.content: Cask ales rest 26 hours before tapping; cellars stay at 11.5 C. Head cellarman: Huw Bellamy. Rules KWI-CEL-26.

items.title: Licence conditions summary
items.content: Under our licences the beer gardens close at 22:30 and door staff are needed after 21:00 on Fridays at 3 sites. Summary KWI-LIC-3.

items.title: Fruit machine income
items.content: Fruit machines are supplied by Spinright Leisure, which splits takings 52/48 in Kittiwake's favour; income is about $3,300 a month per pub. Agreement KWI-FM-5248.

items.title: Brewery tie renegotiation
items.content: Kittiwake wants out of its tie with Fellside Brewery, which charges $47 above market per barrel; walk-away fee is $390,000. Talks on 2026-11-24. Notes KWI-TIE-1124-F.
